cross_component_finding: The page explicitly disclaims a term collision: 'Although collection operators can be used with any array, they are particularly useful when used to evaluate expressions over an array of objects. The term collection is used here in a generic sense to refer to any array of objects, rather than in the specific sense of a [Couchbase collection](../../clusters/data-service/about-buckets-scopes-collections.md).' This is the docs authors proactively flagging exactly the kind of vocabulary overload the ontology needs to keep straight - 'collection' as a SQL++ language term (array of JSON objects) versus 'collection' as the Couchbase data-model primitive (a sub-division of a scope/bucket) are unrelated concepts that must not be merged under one candidate_id despite sharing a name.
